kind: gold-free generation inputs for explicit task variants

selection.kind: prospective task-coverage selection; no new predictions exist
selection.rule: two IDs per nonempty WG x released-track stratum ordered by SHA256(fixed seed + original ID), without replacement; no score, predictions or audit acceptance used to select candidates
